comparison.objective: Connect an M12 sensor cable while preventing the loose sensor from rotating.
comparison.physical_skill: Cap removal, connector alignment, bimanual stabilization, and coupling-ring tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Cap in tray, connector engaged and tightened one turn, hands released and arms returned for 1 s.
comparison.reason: Tests threaded connector mating under reaction torque, not loose-body separation.
